controls.name: Basic Onboarding KYC
controls.description: Single-point identity verification at account creation without ongoing velocity checks.

controls.name: Risk-Based Enhanced KYC
controls.description: Dynamic verification depth scaled according to geographic, transactional, or entity risk factors.

controls.name: Velocity & Transaction Limits
controls.description: Daily/per-transaction limits restricting loss exposure during initial probationary window (e.g. £500/day for 90 days).

controls.name: Real-Time Transaction Monitoring
controls.description: Automated rule-based & ML transaction surveillance screening against mule, smurfing, and anomaly typologies.

controls.name: Device & Network Fingerprinting
controls.description: Hardware ID, proxy detection, and geolocation telemetry to prevent botnets and synthetic identity rings.

controls.name: Confirmation of Payee (CoP)
controls.description: Name-checking service matching destination account name before faster payment execution.

controls.name: New Payee Cooling-Off Delay
controls.description: Mandatory 10–30 second delay for first-time payees allowing out-of-band scam challenge.

controls.name: Automated PEP & Sanctions Screening
controls.description: Daily batch and real-time screening against OpenSanctions, OFAC, and PEP database registers.

controls.name: Source of Wealth & Funds Verification
controls.description: Audited proof of capital origin for private banking and high net worth investment products.

controls.name: Comprehensive Vendor EDD & UBO Audit
controls.description: 25%+ Ultimate Beneficial Ownership verification, license validation with local regulator, and on-site inspection.

controls.name: Human Quality Sampling & Review (10%)
controls.description: Monthly manual re-investigation of a random 10% slice of AI-closed alert triage decisions.

controls.name: Independent Model Risk Validation
controls.description: Third-party audit of AI alert triage false-negative rates, calibration, and explainability records.
